name: heav3n.org
summary:
New Jersey. Say it slowly: New Jerusalem.

heav3n.org is the holy city of Revelation 21, built on the real grounds of Trenton Psychiatric Hospital: every road and building is where the map says it is. The streets are gold, the wall is jasper on twelve foundations of precious stones, the gate is one pearl, and the tree of life stands on the front lawn. Outside the wall the land burns, and the Scarlet Beast with seven heads and ten horns keeps the gate.
